messages.content: The carrier can collect at 08:45, but route confirmation will not arrive until 09:20. Tentatively hold the slot; it is not booked.
The buyer wants an answer before 09:00. I can acknowledge the request, but I am not promising a delivery date.
Two lots are waiting on quality evidence. Neither is released.
The existing task “Confirm route readiness for buyer collection” in this project covers the carrier question. We still need an evidence pack, and Sage owns the release evidence.
